name: @w6w-apps/everhour
description: Everhour time tracking: projects, tasks, time records, timers, timecards, timesheets, expenses, invoices, clients, schedule, time off and reports.

w6w.longDescription:
Everhour is a time tracker that lives inside the project tools a team already uses. This app drives its REST API from a workflow: read and manage projects, sections and tasks (including task estimates and custom fields), log time or run a timer against a task, and read per-user, per-task and per-project time.

Beyond time entries it covers the rest of the Everhour account: clients and their budgets, expenses and expense categories, invoices (create, refresh from tracked time, mark draft/sent/paid, export), the resource-planner schedule, time off with its types and allocations, timecards (clock in/out), weekly timesheets with approval, project/client/user reports, and webhooks for reacting to Everhour events.

Authentication is a single personal API key sent as the X-Api-Key header. The key acts as its owner, so what a workflow can see and change follows that user's role.
